def solution():
    # Define variables
    remaining_payments = [5000, 5000, 5000]
    principal = 100000
    treasury_yield = 0.025
    spread = 0.012

    # Calculate the discount rate and present value of remaining cash flows
    discount_rate = treasury_yield + spread
    make_whole_price = sum(
        payment / ((1 + discount_rate) ** (i + 1))
        for i, payment in enumerate(remaining_payments)
    )
    make_whole_price += principal / ((1 + discount_rate) ** len(remaining_payments))

    # Return the price rounded to the nearest whole number
    return round(make_whole_price)
